review_scope: Published categorical program labels only; not tariff values, income tables, enrollment or policy approval
manual_source_mapping: PG&E CARE Eligibility: Qualify based on other programs lists expanded names for the already supported categorical pathways.
PG&E explicitly identifies Healthy Families A and B as Medi-Cal for Families; these names retain the existing medicaid_medi_cal canonical identifier.
CPUC lists a free-lunch qualifier for NSLP while the PG&E bullet omits it; unqualified NSLP is left for confirmation instead of silently broadening scope.
Both descriptions retain the income-eligible Tribal qualifier for the Head Start path.
Combined CalWORKs-or-Tribal wording does not establish which reported enrollment applies; the user can select a specific supported name.
